units.source_text: 鬼魂去后，这女子浮舟顿觉心头清爽，知觉也稍稍恢复了些。

en.t: After the spirit had gone, the woman Ukifune suddenly felt her heart clear, and her senses returned a little.

units.source_text: 她环顾四周，一个认识的人也没有，只见许多衰老丑陋的僧人。

en.t: She looked around, but there was not a single person she knew; she saw only many old and unattractive monks.

units.source_text: 她觉得仿佛来到了陌生的外国，心中非常悲伤。

en.t: She felt as though she had come to some strange foreign land, and she was deeply saddened.

units.source_text: 她回忆过去的情况，然而连自己住在哪里、叫什么名字也不大记得清楚。

en.t: She tried to recall the past, but she could not clearly remember even where she lived or what her name was.

units.source_text: 她只记得自己不要再活，决心投身河中。

en.t: She remembered only that she had no wish to live any longer and had resolved to throw herself into the river.

units.source_text: 但现在来到了什么地方呢？

en.t: But where had she come to now?

units.source_text: 她努力思索，渐渐地记起来：“有一天晚上，我痛感自身命苦，不堪悲伤，于侍女等睡静之后，偷开边门，走了出去。

en.t: She strained to think, and little by little she remembered: One night, overcome by sorrow and bitterly feeling her own unhappy fate, after the waiting women had fallen asleep, I secretly opened a side door and went out.

units.source_text: 其时风势猛烈，水声凄厉。

en.t: At that time the wind was fierce, and the sound of the water was mournful and terrifying.

units.source_text: 我孤身独行，恐怖之极，前前后后都不省得，只管沿着廊檐走下去，方向也迷失了。

en.t: I walked alone, utterly terrified, unaware of what was before or behind me, simply continuing along the veranda eaves until I lost all sense of direction.

units.source_text: 此时欲回家也回不去，欲前行也不能，口中念着：‘我坚决要离开这人世了！

en.t: At that point I could neither return home nor go forward, and I murmured to myself, I am determined to leave this world!

units.source_text: 我生怕求死不得而被人看见。

en.t: I was terrified that I might fail to die and then be seen by someone.

units.source_text: 鬼也好，怪也好，请你们快来把我吃掉吧！’

en.t: Whether you are demons or monsters, please come quickly and devour me!

units.source_text: 正在迷离恍惚之时，忽见一个相貌非常清秀的男子走近我来，对我说道：‘来，到我那里去吧！’

en.t: While I was in that dazed and drifting state, I suddenly saw a very handsome man approach me and say, Come, let us go to my place!

units.source_text: 我似觉被他抱走，心想这大约是匂亲王吧。

en.t: I seemed to feel him carry me away, and I thought that perhaps this was Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 从此以后我就昏昏沉沉，只觉得这男子把我放在一个不知什么地方，他便无影无踪了。

en.t: After that I was lost in a haze; I only felt that the man set me down somewhere unknown, and then he vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 我想起不能成遂求死的本愿，非常悲伤，哭个不住。

en.t: When I thought that my wish to die had not been fulfilled, I became terribly sad and could not stop crying.

units.source_text: 此后就完全失却知觉，无论如何也记不起了。

en.t: After that I completely lost consciousness, and no matter how I try, I cannot remember anything more.

units.source_text: 现在听这里的人说，我在这里已经过了许多日子。

en.t: Now I hear from the people here that I have already spent many days in this place.

units.source_text: 受这些素不相识的人照顾，我的丑态全被他们看到了。”

en.t: I have been cared for by these people I never knew, and they have seen all of my shameful condition.

units.source_text: 她觉得很可耻。

en.t: She felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 想起求死不得，终于复苏，觉得非常遗憾，反比昏迷不醒之时更加消沉了。

en.t: Remembering that she had failed to die and had finally revived, she felt bitter regret and sank into an even deeper despondency than when she had been unconscious.

units.source_text: 过去失却知觉的时候，有时也还糊里糊涂地吃些东西；如今清醒了，反而连一点汤药也不要喝。

en.t: When she had been unconscious, she would sometimes eat a little in her confusion; now that she was awake, however, she would not drink even a little medicinal broth.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧哭着对她说道：“你怎么生了这么久的重病？

en.t: The younger nun wept as she said to her, Why have you suffered such a serious illness for so long?

units.source_text: 长时间的热度现已退尽，心情也爽朗了，我看了心中正要替你高兴呢。”

en.t: Your long fever has now completely gone, and your spirits have brightened; seeing that, I was just about to rejoice for you.

units.source_text: 她时刻不离地看护她。

en.t: She watched over her without leaving her side for a moment.

units.source_text: 家里的人看见这女子容貌如此美丽，大家怜爱她，尽心地照顾。

en.t: When the people of the household saw how beautiful this woman was, they all pitied and cherished her, caring for her with all their hearts.

units.source_text: 她心中虽然还是想寻死，但她能忍受如此长期的重病，可知抵抗力甚强。

en.t: Although in her heart she still wished to seek death, the fact that she could endure such a long and serious illness showed that her strength of resistance was very great.

units.source_text: 后来渐渐能坐起身，饮食也渐进了，面庞却反而消瘦了些。

en.t: Later she gradually became able to sit up, and her appetite improved, but her face, on the contrary, grew somewhat thinner.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧不胜欢喜，一心希望她早早痊愈。

en.t: The younger nun was overjoyed and hoped with all her heart that she would recover soon.

units.source_text: 有一天她对妹尼僧说道：“请允许我落发为尼。

en.t: One day she said to the younger nun, Please allow me to cut off my hair and become a nun.

units.source_text: 不然我就不愿活在世间。”

en.t: Otherwise I do not wish to go on living in this world.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“你这般美丽的相貌，怎么舍得让你当尼姑呢？”

en.t: The younger nun said, With such a beautiful face as yours, how could I bear to let you become a nun?

units.source_text: 便把她顶上的头发略微剪落几根，给她受了五戒。

en.t: She then cut off just a few hairs from the crown of her head and administered the five precepts to her.

units.source_text: 浮舟心中还不满足，但她本来是个性情温顺的人，所以也不强请。

en.t: Ukifune was still unsatisfied in her heart, but since she was by nature gentle and obedient, she did not press the matter.

units.source_text: 僧都对妹尼僧说：“今已大致无妨了。

en.t: The bishop said to the younger nun, Now there is, for the most part, no longer any danger.

units.source_text: 以后还得好好疗养，求其痊愈。”

en.t: From now on she must continue to recuperate carefully and strive for a full recovery.

units.source_text: 说罢就上山去了。

en.t: Having said this, he went up the mountain.
